scope: Exploratory independent-input follow-up motivated by the records-only answer-matched assay. Match the complete eight-state output signature for the union of all six source tasks across the three fixed groups. Every group's true source and transformed answer codes cancel within pairs. Reuse all old frozen generator maps without fitting on this test; compare groups and random initializations on exactly the same pairs. The query numeric null is the primary endpoint chosen before these new data and group outcomes; raw and full-width outcomes are all reported. Source grades and conditional predicted-answer agreement are reported, without claiming removal of all answer-related computation.
